Surprisingly, this (A)__________________. Why? In those days, people rode horses, but many horses were killed for food.
People needed a new way to travel, and Karl von Drais invented the first bicycle in Germany in 1817. Drais's bicycle had two wooden wheels but no pedals. How did it move without pedals? Well, riders simply pushed the bicycle forward with their feet. The present-day bicycle is the result of many inventors' work in the 19th century.

Whiteout
Whiteout was invented by Bette Graham. In 1956, Graham was working at a bank in Texas, USA. At that time, people had to retype the whole page when they made even a small mistake. Graham was a bad typist, so she needed a solution.
One day, Graham saw some window painters. When they made a mistake, they corrected it by simply painting over it. The next day, she made her own white paint and used it to (B)correct her typing mistakes. Surprisingly, nobody noticed! Soon, everybody at the bank began using it.

Webcam
(C)최초의 웹캠은 커피포트를 지켜보기 위해 발명되었다. In 1991, Dr. Quentin Stafford-Fraser and Dr. Paul Jardetzky were working at a computer lab in England. To work better, they needed lots of coffee. However, there was only one coffee machine in the building. So, they had to make many disappointing trips to the empty coffee pot.
As a solution, the two researchers set up a camera in front of the coffee machine. The camera took pictures of the coffee pot three times a minute. With special software, all the researchers in the building could see the pictures on their local network. No more disappointing trips!

윗글의 밑줄 친 (B)correct와 뜻이 다른 것을 모두 고르면?
questions.explanation: 지문의 (B)correct는 '수정하다, 고치다'라는 뜻의 동사이므로, '올바른'을 뜻하는 형용사 correct가 쓰인 ①과 '정확한'을 뜻하는 형용사 correct가 쓰인 ②의 correct가 지문과 다른 의미로 쓰였다.

questions.answer: The first webcam was invented to watch a coffee pot

questions.question:
다음 주어진 글에 이어질 순서로 알맞은 것은?

Whiteout was invented by Bette Graham. In 1956, Graham was working at a bank in Texas, USA.

(A) One day, Graham saw some window painters. When they made a mistake, they corrected it by simply painting over it.
(B) The next day, she made her own white paint and used it to correct her typing mistakes. Surprisingly, nobody noticed! Soon, everybody at the bank began using it.
(C) At that time, people had to retype the whole page when they made even a small mistake. Graham was a bad typist, so she needed a solution.
questions.explanation: 시간 순서상 먼저 타이핑 문제를 제시하고 (C), 그 후 창문 페인트공들의 아이디어를 보고 (A), 마지막으로 실행하고 결과를 얻은 (B)로 이어지는 것이 자연스럽다.

questions.question:
다음 글을 아래와 같이 요약하고자 할 때 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 각각 찾아 쓰시오.

Mt. Tambora, a volcano in Indonesia, exploded in 1815. The explosion created a huge cloud of ash, so crops failed around the world. As a result, people didn't have enough food to eat. Surprisingly, this made traveling difficult. Why? In those days, people rode horses, but many horses were killed for food.
People needed a new way to travel, and Karl von Drais invented the first bicycle in Germany in 1817. Drais's bicycle had two wooden wheels but no pedals. How did it move without pedals? Well, riders simply pushed the bicycle forward with their feet. The present-day bicycle is the result of many inventors' work in the 19th century.


In 1815, the explosion of Mt. Tambora caused the crop failure, so people did not have ____________ ____________ and killed ____________ for food. As a result, a new method to ____________ was needed, and in 1817, Drais in Germany invented the first bicycle that had ____________ ____________ ____________ without ____________.
questions.explanation: 1815년 탐보라산의 폭발로 인한 흉작으로 충분한 음식이 없었고 말을 식용으로 죽였으며, 결과적으로 이동의 새로운 방법이 필요해졌고 Drais가 페달 없이 두 개의 나무 바퀴가 달린 자전거를 발명했다.
